works.title: Baule Monkey
works.accession_note: Individual accession not published; do not substitute the collection accession or Sketchfab UID.
works.current_holder: African American Research Library and Cultural Center (AARLCC), Broward County Library, Fort Lauderdale, Florida
works.attribution: 3D model by Broward County Library Special Collections (AARLCC), licensed CC BY 4.0; archived by Objaverse 1.0 / Zenodo.
works.source_description:
This monkey figure is referred to as a "gbekre," a brother of the buffalo spirit known as "Guli." It is carved out of natural unstained wood. This figure fulfils a deity role by receiving offerings in agricultural rituals and protects the living. A stylistic characteristic for this statue to be carved with the hands open or with the hands holding a cup for receiving sacrificial offerings.

Source: Objaverse 1.0 / Sketchfab

works.title: Kulango People Royal Female Ancestral Figure
works.accession_note: Individual accession not published; do not substitute the collection accession or Sketchfab UID.
works.current_holder: African American Research Library and Cultural Center (AARLCC), Broward County Library, Fort Lauderdale, Florida
works.attribution: 3D model by Broward County Library Special Collections (AARLCC), licensed CC BY 4.0; archived by Objaverse 1.0 / Zenodo.
works.source_description:
From the Kulango People of Cote D' Ivoire. Carved wood with dark rich brown patina with red and white earth pigments, blue indigo in the form of a royal female figure wearing a pointed carved cap having alternating bands of white kaolin & blue indigo, pronounced face with smooth surface, serene expression, facial scarification, small round ears, ringed neck with white & red pigments, squared shoulders, arms carved away from body ending with hands at waist with fingers pointed inward toward protruding belly button, large pointed & extending breasts, protruding rounded rear end, strong legs & feet standing on top of a heavily carved & detailed throne stool with intricate patterns & adorned with white kaolin and red vegetable pigment, base shows signs of extensive deterioration and age.

Source: Objaverse 1.0 / Sketchfab
